user.title: Connect to Deckhand
user.description: Enter the address of the Mac that runs the Deckhand app. The port is 8942 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Deckhand there. Check the address, that the app is running on the Mac (it shows in the menu bar), and that Home Assistant can reach that Mac on your network.

abort.already_configured: That Deckhand is already set up.
